name: io.github.mguttmann/action1-mcp
title: Action1 RMM (unofficial)
description: Unofficial MCP server for the Action1 RMM API: fleet queries, scripts, updates, guarded changes.

environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Action1 API base URL of your region: https://app.eu.action1.com/api/3.0 (Europe), https://app.action1.com/api/3.0 (North America), https://app.na-2.action1.com/api/3.0 (North America 2), https://app.uk.action1.com/api/3.0 (United Kingdom) or https://app.au.action1.com/api/3.0 (Australia).

environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_ORG_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Action1 organization UUID; each tool can override it with org_id.

environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: API client ID from the Action1 console, Settings > API Credentials (api-key-...@action1.com). It can run code on every managed endpoint: treat it like an admin password.

environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API client secret, shown once when the credential is created.

environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: true lets tools that change state (run scripts, deploy updates, reboot, uninstall) execute; each call still needs confirm "YES" and dry_run false. Default false: query only.
